import gzip
import hashlib
import io
import json
import subprocess


def run(req_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run(["python3", "solution.py"], input=req_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.stdout


def build(members):
    return json.dumps({"members": members}).encode()


# public example
req = {"members": [{"path": "example/item.txt", "content_b64": "ZXhhbXBsZQo=", "mode": 420}]}
out = run(json.dumps(req).encode())
res = json.loads(out)
assert res["format"] == "tar+gzip"
bundle = base64.b64decode(res["bundle_b64"])
assert hashlib.sha256(bundle).hexdigest() == res["sha256"]
# gzip checks
assert bundle[:2] == b"\x1f\x8b"
assert (bundle[3] & 0x01) == 0  # no FNAME
assert (bundle[3] & 0x04) == 0  # no extra
assert bundle[4:8] == b"\x00\x00\x00\x00"  # mtime=0
data = gzip.decompress(bundle)
# tar checks
assert len(data) % 512 == 0
hdr = data[:512]
assert hdr[0:15] == b"example/item.txt"
assert hdr[100:107] == b"%06o\x00" % 420
assert hdr[124:136] == b"%011o\x00" % 9
assert hdr[136:148] == b"%011o\x00" % 0
assert hdr[156] == ord("0")
assert hdr[257:263] == b"ustar\x00"
assert hdr[263:265] == b"00"
assert data[148:156] != b"        "
content = data[512:521]
assert content == b"example\n"
# trailing zeros
tail = data[-1024:]
assert tail == b"\x00" * 1024
# content block then padding
assert data[521:512+512] == b"\x00" * (512 - 9)
# determinism
out2 = run(json.dumps(req).encode())
assert out == out2
print("basic ok")

# empty content
req = {"members": [{"path": "a.txt", "content_b64": "", "mode": 0}]}
out = run(json.dumps(req).encode())
res = json.loads(out)
bundle = base64.b64decode(res["bundle_b64"])
data = gzip.decompress(bundle)
assert len(data) == 512 + 1024
print("empty ok")

# ordering: unicode code-point order, 64 members
mems = []
for i in range(64):
    mems.append({"path": f"z{chr(0x400 + i):04d}.bin", "content_b64": "AA==", "mode": 493})
out = run(json.dumps({"members": mems}).encode())
res = json.loads(out)
data = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(res["bundle_b64"]))
names = []
off = 0
while off < len(data) - 1024:
    n = data[off:off+100].split(b"\x00")[0].decode()
    names.append(n)
    off += 512 * (1 + ((data[off+124:off+136].decode().strip("0") or "0") and (1 if data[off+124:off+135] != b"0" * 12 else 0)))
    off += 512
names2 = []

while off < len(data) - 1024:
    n = data[off:off+100].split(b"\x00")[0].decode()
    size = int(data[off+124:off+135].decode().strip() or "0", 8)
    names2.append(n)
    off += 512 * (1 + (size + 511) // 512)
assert names2 == sorted(names2)
assert len(names2) == 64
print("order ok")

# invalid cases
def expect_err(b):

expect_err(b"not json")
expect_err(b'{"members": []}')
expect_err(b'{"members": [{"path":"/a","content_b64":"AA==","mode":0}]}')
expect_err(b'{"members": [{"path":"a\\b","content_b64":"AA==","mode":0}]}')

expect_err(b'{"members": [{"path":"a//b","content_b64":"AA==","mode":0}]}')

    {"path": "b", "content_b64": "AA==", "mode": 0}]}).encode()

    {"path": "b/second.txt", "content_b64": base64.b64encode(b"hello\n").decode(), "mode": 493},
    {"path": "a.txt", "content_b64": base64.b64encode(b"world").decode(), "mode": 384},
